caption.en: Pastores á Belén as No. 23 in Cánticos espirituales con música (Las Vegas, New Mexico, 1916), pages 20 and 21: the earliest printing of the song we have seen, with no poet or composer named.

caption.en: The editors' note facing the first song: the people of their region know these songs, sing them and love them as they are, so the book leaves them untouched as far as it can.

alt.en: A colour photograph of an adobe church under a clear blue sky, with two square wooden bell towers, each holding a dark bell and topped by a cross, a wooden gable and balcony between them, and a concrete path leading to the door between low, twisted trees.

caption.en: The Catholic church of Tomé, New Mexico, in 2014; Father J. B. Ralliere, who gathered the songs the 1916 book printed, was parish priest of Tomé by 1859.
caption.es: La iglesia católica de Tomé, Nuevo México, en 2014; el padre J. B. Ralliere, que recopiló los cantos que imprimió el libro de 1916, ya era párroco de Tomé en 1859.
